info.title: SAR Fleet Service WebSocket API
info.description: Live telemetry, alerts, commands and control changes. Connect, send `auth` with a session token within 5 s, then `subscribe`. Close codes: 4400 malformed message, 4401 not authenticated or session ended, 4403 not permitted, 4408 timeout, 4429 too slow (reconnect and resync).

station.description: The ground station, behind its gateway (ADR 0016).

sendToConsole.summary: Messages the station sends to a console.
